title: manihot tripartita subsp. xavantinensis
intro: Manihot tripartita subsp. xavantinensis, commonly known as Xavantina cassava, is a plant species of the genus Manihot, native to Brazil. The plant's roots have been used for their medicinal properties, providing various health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects. The therapeutic actions of Xavantina cassava include wound healing, reducing inflammation, and exerting antimicrobial activities, likely due to the presence of bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins. However, more research is needed to fully understand the extent of its health benefits and therapeutic actions.
